methods: genotype-likelihood EM population frequencies; f4-ratio and Patterson D; autosome-block jackknife
unsampled: Historical Plains wolf (C. l. nubilus; C. variabilis Wied-Neuwied, 1841)
interpretation: A significant positive coyote D supports excess coyote-lineage allele sharing relative to the listed western comparator. The wolf f4 ratio is conditional on the specified reference model; it is not a direct hybridization fraction. This script does not infer dog ancestry.
